dimensions.name: Backend API Design
dimensions.description: Good candidates demonstrate the ability to design and build scalable REST APIs using Python or Java while applying strong knowledge of data structures and algorithms.
dimensions.jd_evidence: Design and build scalable REST APIs; Python or Java; Data structures and algorithms

dimensions.name: Production Ownership & Reliability
dimensions.description: Good candidates show a strong track record of owning services end-to-end, actively participating in on-call rotations, and systematically improving system performance and reliability.
dimensions.jd_evidence: Own services in production end to end; Participate in on-call rotations; Improve system performance and reliability

dimensions.name: Database & Distributed Systems
dimensions.description: Good candidates exhibit deep proficiency in working with relational databases like Postgres or MySQL and designing resilient distributed systems.

dimensions.name: Engineering Workflow & Collaboration
dimensions.description: Good candidates effectively collaborate with cross-functional product and frontend teams while utilizing Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing best practices.
dimensions.jd_evidence: Collaborate with product and frontend teams; Git; CI/CD; Automated testing

questions.text: For the NABHA Telemedicine Platform, how did you design the backend REST APIs to handle patient data securely?
